content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICMR NIHR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / www.icmr.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 22-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICMR National Institute of Health Research (ICMR NIHR), located in Dibrugarh, Assam, for hiring specialized consultants on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the positions available in ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: There are two primary positions available under this notification: Senior Consultant (Scientific - Non-Medical) and Consultant (Finance), totaling 2 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must send their filled application forms along with supporting self-attested documents via Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form is 22 October 2026. Applications received after this date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Consultant (Scientific - Non-Medical) position, the age limit is set between 40 years as the minimum and 70 years as the maximum age.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for Consultant (Finance)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Consultant (Finance) post must possess a Post Graduate or Bachelor degree in relevant subjects such as Management, Law, Public Administration, Finance & Accounts, CA, ICWAI, Commerce, or Economics.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Consultant (Scientific - Non-Medical) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,50,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to these contractual positions at the ICMR National Institute of Health Research.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the offline application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with self-attested documents should be sent to: ICMR-NIHR (Formerly ICMR-RMRCNE) Dibrugarh, Bokul, Lahowal, Assam 786010.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes the shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a written test, interview, or personal discussion as determined by the institute.
